about: 29-year-old backend engineer in Toronto weighing a startup offer.

items.text: Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Payments, Toronto, September 2022 to present. Led the migration of the payments ledger from a monolith to services.
Software Engineer at Northwind Logistics, Waterloo, June 2019 to August 2022. Built route-optimisation APIs in Go.
B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Waterloo, graduated 2019.
Location: Toronto, Canada. Skills endorsed: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, distributed systems, team leadership.
Maintains 'ledgerctl', an open-source Rust command-line tool for auditing double-entry ledgers, 340 stars, 11 contributors.
About 60 percent of public commits in the last year are in Rust, the rest in Go.
Gave a talk titled 'Rewriting our ledger without downtime' at a local meetup, slides posted publicly.
Asked ChatGPT how startup equity, vesting cliffs and strike prices work, and what a fair salary-for-equity trade looks like.
Asked ChatGPT to compare relocating to Berlin with staying in Toronto for a seed-stage startup offer.
Asked ChatGPT how much runway a founder should have saved before quitting a job.
Photos from a week of hiking in Banff, caption: 'weekends are for the mountains'.
Post with a friend who runs a small startup, caption: 'proud of this one, no idea how they do it'.
Recent post: 'Ten years in, I keep wondering what building something from zero would feel like.'
